components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date

          format: date

## Summary

I implemented the `customerCode` assignment for `POST /api/owners`, formatted `<LAST3>-<NNNN>`.

**What I changed:**

1. **New pipeline step** `AssignCustomerCode.java` — the core logic. It reads the just-built `Owner` (via `@Val`), computes `LAST3` = upper-cased first three letters of `lastName`, and `NNNN` = `ownerRepository.findAll().size() + 1` (one more than the current owner count, since the new owner isn't saved yet), then sets `customerCode` as `String.format("%s-%04d", last3, sequence)` — e.g. `SMI-0007`.

2. **`owners.POST.yml`** — wired the new `assignCode` step between `build` and `save`, under the same `govern: [ transaction ]`.

3. **`Owner` entity** — added a persisted `customerCode` field (`@Column(name = "customer_code")`) with getter/setter, so the value survives the save and is read back on `GET /api/owners/{id}`.

4. **`openapi.yml`** — added a read-only `customerCode` property to the `Owner` schema, so the generated `OwnerDto` exposes it and MapStruct maps it automatically (by name).

5. **DB schemas** — added the `customer_code` column to all four `schema.sql` variants (hsqldb, h2, mysql, postgres).

**Verification:** `AcceptanceTest.coreFormatAndGlobalSequence` passes — it confirms the `SMI-`/`JON-` prefixes and that the two owners get consecutive global sequence numbers. The full `./mvnw test` run is `BUILD SUCCESS`.

One design note: the sequence is a global count of all owners (`findAll().size() + 1`), matching the spec's "one more than the current number of owners." Because it's count-based rather than a reserved counter, concurrent creates in the same transaction window could in principle collide — but that matches the specification as written, and the test exercises the sequential behaviour.
